mentions.name: QR-coded storage box organizer
mentions.description: This web app lets users create boxes and add images or text describing what's inside, then generates a QR code to tape to each box; scanning the code brings up the stored description and images. It makes finding items in a storage unit easy without physically opening every tote.
mentions.problem: Finding items in a storage unit previously required removing all the totes and looking inside them; this app replaces that with a quick QR scan.
mentions.audience: A person organizing personal storage, keeping track of what's inside boxes in a storage unit
mentions.source_excerpt: its a web app where you make boxes, add images or text of what's in the box. then get a qr code that you can tape to the box and scan to see the text or images in the web app.
